about:
June Fabrics is based in Honolulu, Hawaii, and ships fabric orders to all 50 United States, U.S. territories, P.O. boxes, and Japan. The company does not disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or the names of its founders in its public materials.

The business operates as an online fabric retailer, stocking polyester-cotton blends (65% polyester/35% cotton), 100% cotton broadcloth, 100% cotton sheeting, and 100% cotton palaka prints. All listed fabrics are 45 inches wide and priced between $5.00 and $9.00 per unit. Inventory includes patterned designs such as teal, paisley blue, olive/white, pink, white/black, and multiple palaka colorways (black/red, seagreen, UH green, red, beige, purple, ilima yellow, black, avocado, fuchsia). Orders are fulfilled from stock through an e-commerce platform.

The product range serves quilting, apparel, and craft customers, though the company does not explicitly name target industries. Payment is accepted via Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, and PayPal. Customer contact is available by phone at  or email at .

No public statement describes the company's origins or what sets it apart beyond its shipping coverage and fabric selection.
